_comment: The one thing a custom card can carry that GitHub's generated card structurally cannot.
GitHub's default card already draws the owner, the repository name, the description, the
owner's avatar, a live contributors/issues/stars/forks row and a proportional language bar,
and it updates itself. A custom card that restates that metadata is a downgrade: it drops
four live counters and freezes the rest into a snapshot. See social-preview/README.md.
An install command is not in any GitHub metadata field, so no generated card can ever show
it — and for something you install and run, it is the most useful line on the card. That is
the bar for appearing in this file, and appearing in this file is what makes a repository
eligible for a custom card at all.
Every command below is copied from that repository's own README, and is the first command a
reader there is given. Check it against the README when the README changes.
